title: Fish Gelatin Supplement and Omega-3 Supplement in Obese or Overweight Subjects With Insulin Resistance

sections.abstract: The present study was conducted to test whether a fish gelatin supplement combined with an omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid supplement can exert beneficial and sex-specific effects on insulin sensitivity, glucose tolerance, indicators of insulin secretion, blood pressure, lipid metabolism, inflammation and energy intake in obese or overweight insulin-resistant men and women. The investigators hypothesis is that fish gelatin improves insulin sensitivity, glucose tolerance, lipid profile and reduces inflammation in obese or overweight insulin-resistant men and women.
